meta.title: NestSelf — support for work, and everything around it
meta.description: Workplace wellbeing that gives employees access to psychological, legal and financial guidance through one clear experience.

support.title: You do not need a perfect reason to start.
support.lead: A difficult week. A question you keep putting off. A decision that feels bigger on your own. Choose the kind of guidance that helps.
support.alt: Two friends having a conversation on a bench outdoors

psychological.title: A little space to talk
psychological.body: Psychological support for what you are carrying, at work or outside it.

legal.title: A clearer way through
legal.body: Legal guidance to understand a question and the options in front of you.

financial.title: More clarity about money

how.title: Your first step can be small.
how.lead: A clear path from choosing support to understanding what happens next.

step1.title: Start where you are.
step1.body: Choose a support area and see who can help. You do not have to work out everything first.

step2.title: See the details.
step2.body: Check the format, availability and your workplace coverage before making a choice.

step3.title: Take the next step.
step3.body: Begin a conversation or confirm an appointment, with the important details in front of you.

employer.title: A workplace benefit with people at its centre.
employer.body: Bring psychological, legal and financial guidance into one understandable employee experience, with a separate space to manage the programme.
employer.alt: A family together outdoors among autumn trees

privacy.title: Know what you share. Know who can see it.
privacy.body: Understand how conversations, appointments and employer reporting are separated before you share something personal.
privacy.dialogLead: Your own support history, assigned professional access and the employer's programme view have different purposes.

rows.employee: Employee: your own conversations and appointments.
rows.advisor: Assigned advisor: the scope needed for your assigned case.
rows.employer: Employer: eligibility administration, programme budget and protected aggregate reporting, without individual support content.
rows.exceptional: Exceptional access: a defined, authorised and recorded operational process.

privacy.disclaimer: This is the proposed design model, not a live privacy notice or proof of implemented access control.

employers.title: A benefit built around people
employers.lead: Give your team access to psychological, legal and financial guidance in one place.
employers.hrAggregates: Aggregates only: the employer view shows programme-level totals, not individual support details.
employers.hrProtected: Protected is not zero: when a group is too small to report safely, the value is protected rather than suppressed.
employers.hrRoles: Roles enforced server-side: UI visibility follows the role model, but access control is determined by the server, not the client.
